<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Trainer's Odyssey - Ultimate Pokémon Hub</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Exo+2:wght@300;400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --primary: #FF0000;
            --secondary: #3B4CCA;
            --accent: #FFDE00;
            --dark: #0A0E27;
            --darker: #050711;
            --light: #F5F5F5;
            --electric: #F7D02C;
            --fire: #F08030;
            --water: #6890F0;
            --grass: #78C850;
            --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --glow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Exo 2', sans-serif;
            background: var(--darker);
            color: var(--light);
            overflow-x: hidden;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Animated Background */
        .bg-pattern {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: -1;
            background: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(59, 76, 202, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 40% 20%, rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%);
            animation: bgFloat 20s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes bgFloat {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
            50% { transform: translate(-20px, 20px); }
        }

        /* Header */
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--dark) 0%, rgba(59, 76, 202, 0.2) 100%);
            border-bottom: 3px solid var(--primary);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            will-change: transform;
        }

        /* Slides out of the way when scrolling down; returns on scroll up */
        header.header-hidden {
            transform: translateY(-100%);
            box-shadow: none;
        }

        /* Never hide while the user is interacting with the menu */
        header:focus-within {
            transform: none;
        }

        nav {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0.8rem 2rem;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 0.6rem 1rem;
        }

        .logo {
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--primary);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.4rem;
            list-style: none;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--light);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            position: relative;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .nav-links a::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -5px;
            left: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            transition: width 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover::after {
            width: 100%;
        }

        .admin-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #CC0000);
            padding: 0.4rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 25px;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent);
            color: var(--light);
            font-family: inherit;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .admin-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }

        /* Hero Section */
        .hero {
            padding: 6rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--dark));
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            animation: heroRotate 30s linear infinite;
        }

        @keyframes heroRotate {
            from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
            to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            font-size: 3rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 
                4px 4px 0 var(--primary),
                -2px -2px 0 var(--secondary),
                0 0 30px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.5);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            animation: slideIn 1s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes slideIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-30px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            color: var(--light);
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            animation: slideIn 1s ease-out 0.2s backwards;
        }

        /* Main Content */
        .container {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 4rem 2rem;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            font-size: 2rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--primary);
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        .section-title::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 60%;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent), transparent);
        }

        /* Grid Layouts */
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
            gap: 2rem;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 2rem;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%;
            left: -50%;
            width: 200%;
            height: 200%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
            pointer-events: none; /* decorative glow must not swallow clicks on card buttons */
        }

        .card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2), var(--glow);
        }

        .card h3 {
            color: var(--accent);
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .card p {
            color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.8);
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .card-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;
            padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        /* Buttons */
        .btn {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 0.8rem 2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary), #2a3ba8);
            color: white;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 25px;
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(59, 76, 202, 0.4);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #CC0000);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }

        /* Modal Styles */
        .modal {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
            z-index: 2000;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
        }

        .modal.active {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal-content {
            background: var(--dark);
            border: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 3rem;
            max-width: 800px;
            width: 90%;
            max-height: 90vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            animation: modalSlide 0.3s ease-out;
        }

        @keyframes modalSlide {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9) translateY(-20px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
        }

        .close-modal {
            position: absolute;
            top: 1rem;
            right: 1rem;
            background: var(--primary);
            border: none;
            color: white;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .close-modal:hover {
            transform: rotate(90deg);
            background: #CC0000;
        }

        /* Form Styles */
        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }

        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .form-group input,
        .form-group textarea,
        .form-group select {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0.8rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: var(--light);
            font-family: 'Exo 2', sans-serif;
            font-size: 1rem;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .form-group input:focus,
        .form-group textarea:focus,
        .form-group select:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .form-group textarea {
            min-height: 120px;
            resize: vertical;
        }

        /* Video Embed */
        .video-container {
            position: relative;
            padding-bottom: 56.25%;
            height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 15px;
            margin: 2rem 0;
            border: 3px solid var(--accent);
        }

        .video-container iframe {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        /* Social Links */
        .social-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .social-links a {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 2px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
        }

        .social-links a:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(5deg);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            background: var(--accent);
            color: var(--dark);
        }

        /* Filter Section */
        .filters {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .filter-btn {
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 25px;
            color: var(--light);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .filter-btn.active,
        .filter-btn:hover {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: var(--dark);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Admin Panel */
        .admin-panel {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(59, 76, 202, 0.1));
            border: 3px solid var(--primary);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2rem;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        .admin-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        /* Walkthrough specific */
        .game-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .game-header::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background: url('data:image/svg+xml,<svg width="100" height="100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="2" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"/></svg>');
            opacity: 0.3;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .game-header h2 {
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            position: relative;
        }

        .walkthrough-nav {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin: 2rem 0;
        }

        .walkthrough-part {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 250px;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .walkthrough-part:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
        }

        /* Footer */
        footer {
            background: var(--darker);
            border-top: 3px solid var(--primary);
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 4rem;
        }

        footer p {
            color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.6);
        }

        /* ===== Walkthrough guide content (FireRed Part 1) ===== */
        .wt-part-wrap {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 15px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }
        .wt-part-wrap > h3 { color: var(--accent); font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
        .wt-guide { color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.92); line-height: 1.8; }
        .wt-guide p { margin: 0 0 1rem; }
        .wt-guide a { color: #8fb0ff; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
        .wt-guide a:hover { color: var(--accent); }
        .wt-lead { font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
        .wt-h {
            font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--primary);
            margin: 2.5rem 0 1rem;
            scroll-margin-top: 1rem;
        }
        .wt-h2 {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin: 1.8rem 0 0.6rem;
            padding-left: 0.7rem;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
            scroll-margin-top: 1rem;
        }
        .wt-px { image-rendering: pixelated; }
        .wt-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; }

        details.wt-collapse {
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 12px;
            margin: 1.5rem 0;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }
        details.wt-collapse > summary {
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            user-select: none;
        }
        details.wt-collapse > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
        details.wt-collapse > summary::after {
            content: '+';
            width: 28px; height: 28px;
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 50%;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        details.wt-collapse[open] > summary::after { content: '\2212'; }
        details.wt-collapse > summary:hover { background: rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.08); }
        details.wt-collapse > summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
        .wt-collapse-body { padding: 0.4rem 1.2rem 1.2rem; }

        .wt-toc-list, .wt-toc-list ul { padding-left: 1.4rem; margin: 0; }
        .wt-toc-list li { margin: 0.2rem 0; }

        .wt-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin: 1.2rem 0; }
        .wt-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
        .wt-table.wt-narrow { max-width: 620px; }
        .wt-table caption { text-align: left; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 0.4rem; }
        .wt-table th, .wt-table td {
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.25);
            padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
            text-align: left;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .wt-table thead th { background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.25); color: var(--accent); }
        .wt-table tbody th { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: var(--accent); white-space: nowrap; }
        .wt-game {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--secondary);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin-right: 0.3rem;
        }
        .wt-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-weight: 600; }

        .wt-townrow { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .wt-townrow p { flex: 1 1 280px; }
        .wt-figure { margin: 0; text-align: center; flex: none; }
        .wt-figure img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; border: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; }
        .wt-figure figcaption { font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); margin-top: 0.3rem; }

        .wt-starters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
        .wt-starter {
            text-align: center;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1rem;
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem;
        }
        .wt-evos { width: 100%; margin-top: 0.6rem; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3); padding-top: 0.6rem; }
        .wt-evo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
        .wt-evo .type-badge { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem; margin: 0.1rem 0.2rem 0 0; }

        .wt-rivals { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1.2rem 0; }
        .wt-rival { border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); }
        .wt-rival-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.25); padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; }
        .wt-rival-body { padding: 0.9rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
        .wt-trainer { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; }
        .wt-trainer dl, .wt-mon dl { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; }
        .wt-trainer dt, .wt-mon dt { color: var(--accent); font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
        .wt-trainer dd, .wt-mon dd { margin: 0 0 0.3rem; }
        .wt-balls { width: 100%; display: flex; gap: 2px; }
        .wt-mon { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3); padding-top: 0.9rem; }
        .wt-moves { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; width: 100%; display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .wt-moves li { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; }
        .wt-moves .type-badge { font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem; margin: 0 0 0 0.4rem; }

        .wt-party { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }
        .wt-party li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.15rem 0.7rem 0.15rem 0.3rem; font-weight: 600; }
        .wt-mart { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 0.8rem; margin: 0.6rem 0; }
        .wt-mart-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.25); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; }
        .wt-mart-item strong { margin-left: auto; color: var(--accent); }
        .wt-rivals.wt-single { grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 480px); }
        .type-rock { background: #B8A038; color: white; }
        .type-ground { background: #E0C068; color: var(--dark); }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 1.8rem;
            }

            .section-title {
                font-size: 1.5rem;
            }

            .logo {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }

            nav {
                padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
                gap: 0.4rem;
            }

            .logo {
                animation: none;
            }

            .nav-links {
                gap: 1.1rem;
                flex-wrap: nowrap;
                overflow-x: auto;
                width: 100%;
                padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
                scrollbar-width: none;
            }

            .nav-links::-webkit-scrollbar {
                display: none;
            }

            .nav-links li {
                flex: none;
            }

            .modal-content {
                padding: 2.5rem 1rem 1.5rem;
            }

            .wt-part-wrap {
                padding: 1rem;
            }

            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        /* Loading Animation */
        .loading {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        /* Success Message */
        .success-msg {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(120, 200, 80, 0.2), rgba(78, 200, 80, 0.1));
            border: 2px solid var(--grass);
            color: var(--grass);
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin: 1rem 0;
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .error-msg {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.2), rgba(200, 0, 0, 0.1));
            border: 2px solid var(--primary);
            color: var(--primary);
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin: 1rem 0;
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Type badges for Pokemon */
        .type-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin: 0.2rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .type-fire { background: var(--fire); color: white; }
        .type-water { background: var(--water); color: white; }
        .type-grass { background: var(--grass); color: white; }
        .type-electric { background: var(--electric); color: var(--dark); }
        .type-poison { background: #A040A0; color: white; }
        .type-flying { background: #A890F0; color: white; }
        .type-normal { background: #A8A878; color: white; }

        /* Search Bar */
        .search-container {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 2rem auto;
            position: relative;
        }

        .search-input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 1rem 3rem 1rem 1.5rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 30px;
            color: var(--light);
            font-size: 1rem;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .search-input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            right: 1.5rem;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="bg-pattern"></div>

    <!-- Header -->

                        <h3>Latest PSP Gameplay</h3>

                            <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/videoseries?list=PLYourPlaylistID" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
                        </div>

                <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-top: 4rem;">Connect With Me</h2>

                    </a>
                    <a href="https://youtube.com/@handholdhavoc" target="_blank" title="Handhold Havoc YouTube">
                        <span>🎮</span>

                        <span>📷</span>
                    </a>

        <!-- Walkthroughs Section -->

                    <span class="search-icon">🔍</span>

                <div class="filters">
                    <button class="filter-btn active" onclick="filterWalkthroughs('all')">All Games</button>
                    <button class="filter-btn" onclick="filterWalkthroughs('official')">Official Games</button>
                    <button class="filter-btn" onclick="filterWalkthroughs('romhack')">ROM Hacks</button>
                </div>

                <div id="walkthroughs-grid" class="grid">

        <!-- About Section -->
        <section id="about" class="hidden-section">
            <div class="container">
                <h2 class="section-title">About Trainer's Odyssey</h2>
                
                <div class="card" style="max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 3rem;">
                    <h3>Welcome, Trainers!</h3>
                    <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 2; margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        Trainer's Odyssey is your ultimate destination for comprehensive Pokémon walkthroughs, ROM hack showcases, 
                        and gaming content. I've dedicated this platform to helping trainers navigate through official Pokémon games 
                        and discover incredible fan-made adventures.
                    </p>
                    <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 2; margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        From detailed episode-by-episode walkthroughs with embedded YouTube videos to in-depth guides on items, 
                        legendaries, and optimal strategies, this site is built for both casual players and hardcore enthusiasts. 
                        I also create my own ROM hacks, which you can find in the dedicated section!
                    </p>
                    <p style="font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 2; margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        Beyond Pokémon, my Handhold Havoc channel features PSP gameplay from classics like Naruto, Dragon Ball Z, 
                        God of War, and more. Join me on this gaming odyssey!
                    </p>

                    <div style="margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 2px solid rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.3);">

                            <a href="https://youtube.com/@trainersodyssey323" target="_blank">▶</a>

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

    <!-- Admin Login Modal -->
    <div id="admin-login-modal" class="modal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <button class="close-modal" onclick="closeModal('admin-login-modal')">&times;</button>
            <h2 style="color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; text-align: center;">Admin Login</h2>
            
            <form onsubmit="adminLogin(event)">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Password</label>
                    <input type="password" id="admin-password" required>
                </div>
                <div id="login-message"></div>
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">Login</button>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Walkthrough Modal -->
    <div id="add-walkthrough-modal" class="modal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <button class="close-modal" onclick="closeModal('add-walkthrough-modal')">&times;</button>
            <h2 style="color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;">Add New Walkthrough</h2>
            
            <form onsubmit="addWalkthrough(event)">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Game Title</label>
                    <input type="text" id="wt-title" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Game Type</label>
                    <select id="wt-type" required>
                        <option value="official">Official Game</option>
                        <option value="romhack">ROM Hack</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Description</label>
                    <textarea id="wt-description" required></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Cover Image URL (optional)</label>
                    <input type="url" id="wt-image">
                </div>
                <div id="add-walkthrough-message"></div>
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">Add Walkthrough</button>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add Walkthrough Part Modal -->
    <div id="add-part-modal" class="modal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <button class="close-modal" onclick="closeModal('add-part-modal')">&times;</button>
            <h2 style="color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;">Add Walkthrough Part</h2>
            
            <form onsubmit="addWalkthroughPart(event)">
                <input type="hidden" id="part-game-id">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Part Title (e.g., "Part 1: Pallet Town to Pewter City")</label>
                    <input type="text" id="part-title" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>YouTube Video URL</label>
                    <input type="url" id="part-video" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Written Guide</label>
                    <textarea id="part-content" required style="min-height: 200px;"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Key Items & Tips</label>
                    <textarea id="part-tips" placeholder="List important items, strategies, and tips for this section"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div id="add-part-message"></div>
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">Add Part</button>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Add My ROM Hack Modal -->
    <div id="add-myromhack-modal" class="modal">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <button class="close-modal" onclick="closeModal('add-myromhack-modal')">&times;</button>
            <h2 style="color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Press Start 2P', cursive; font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;">Add Your ROM Hack</h2>
            
            <form onsubmit="addMyRomHack(event)">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>ROM Hack Title</label>
                    <input type="text" id="mrh-title" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Description</label>
                    <textarea id="mrh-description" required></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Features (one per line)</label>
                    <textarea id="mrh-features" placeholder="New region&#10;Custom Pokémon&#10;Enhanced difficulty"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Version</label>
                    <input type="text" id="mrh-version" placeholder="e.g., v1.0">
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Patch Download URL</label>
                    <input type="url" id="mrh-patch" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Dev Log / Updates</label>
                    <textarea id="mrh-devlog"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>Cover Image URL (optional)</label>
                    <input type="url" id="mrh-image">
                </div>
                <div id="add-myromhack-message"></div>
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">Add ROM Hack</button>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- View Walkthrough Detail Modal -->
    <div id="walkthrough-detail-modal" class="modal">
        <div class="modal-content" style="max-width: 1200px;">
            <button class="close-modal" onclick="closeModal('walkthrough-detail-modal')">&times;</button>
            <div id="walkthrough-detail-content"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

        <div class="social-links" style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">

            <a href="https://www.instagram.com/pokebattle_reels" target="_blank">📷</a>
        </div>
    </footer>

The player is shown a list of controls in order of importance, then with a mission statement from the games' developers. Afterward, the researcher of the Kanto region, Professor Oak, appears on screen and explains a few basics.<\/p>\n  <p>Firstly, Professor Oak asks you to choose your gender and then select a name (7 characters long). Using the Control Pad will allow you to move the cursor and the Select Button to move through three pages of upper-case letters, lower-case letters, and other characters. On this screen, pressing the A Button will select a letter whereas pressing the B Button will delete the previous one. When you are done, press Start or select OK in the bottom-right corner.<\/p>\n  <p>Next, Professor Oak introduces his grandson, who happens to be your rival. The professor is having trouble remembering the boy's name and asks if you might know. Choose his name from a list of preset names or select a new one. With that done, you are transported into the world of Pokémon to begin your adventure!<\/p>\n\n  <div class=\"wt-table-wrap\">\n    <table class=\"wt-table wt-narrow\">\n      <caption>Default Names<\/caption>\n      <thead><tr><th><\/th><th>Pokémon FireRed &amp; LeafGreen<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>\n      <tbody>\n        <tr><th scope=\"row\">Rival<\/th><td>Green, Gary, Kaz, Toru<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><th scope=\"row\">Player<\/th><td>Red, Ash, Kene, Geki<\/td><\/tr>\n      <\/tbody>\n    <\/table>\n  <\/div>\n\n  <h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr1-pallet\">Pallet Town<\/h4>\n  <div class=\"wt-townrow\">\n    <figure class=\"wt-figure\">\n      <img src=\"@@IMG1@@\" alt=\"Pallet Town map\" width=\"300\" height=\"250\" class=\"wt-px\">\n      <figcaption>Pallet Town<\/figcaption>\n    <\/figure>\n    <p>Your journey begins in Pallet Town, in the southwest part of the Kanto region. It is a rather small, quaint town with only three buildings. The western house belongs to you and Mom, while the eastern one is home to your rival and his sister. The large building to the south is Professor Oak's Laboratory. The north part of town leads to the tall grasses of Route 1, and the waters to the south open to Route 21.<\/p>\n  <\/div>\n\n  <details class=\"wt-collapse\" open>\n    <summary>Available id=\"fr1-home\">Home<\/h4>\n  <h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr1-2f\">2F<\/h5>\n  <p>Your journey begins in your bedroom, with you standing in front of your Nintendo Entertainment System. Now that you can control your character, the various buttons and their effects are as follows:<\/p>\n\n  <div class=\"wt-table-wrap\">\n    <table class=\"wt-table wt-narrow\">\n      <thead><tr><th>Input<\/th><th>Effect(s)<\/th><\/tr><\/thead>\n      <tbody>\n        <tr><td>+Control Pad<\/td><td>Moves character; moves cursor in a menu<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><td>A Button<\/td><td>Interact with people and the environment; select menu options<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><td>B Button<\/td><td>Cancel a selection; exit a menu<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><td>Start<\/td><td>Opens the main menu<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><td>Select<\/td><td>Sort items; use a registered item<\/td><\/tr>\n        <tr><td>L Button, R Button<\/td><td>Activates the Help System<\/td><\/tr>\n      <\/tbody>\n    <\/table>\n  <\/div>\n\n  <p>The PC in the corner can be used to store items in your item storage and check your Mailbox.<\/p>\n  <p>Your Bag has three pockets: one for Items, one for Key Items, and one for Poké Balls. Each pocket can hold up to 42 different items and up to 999 of each item. If a pocket becomes full, it would be necessary to use or toss some items before obtaining anything new. The PC can hold up to 30 different items from the Items pocket. Deposit Item and Withdraw Item allow for moving items between inventory and storage. A Potion is already in storage, so select Withdraw Item and choose it to add to your Bag. Press the B Button to close the menus and return to your bedroom. To save the game, press Start to open the main menu, select Save, and then Yes. When the menu disappears, your progress is saved and it is safe to exit the game.<\/p>\n  <p>Mail is a type of held item. You may leave a note on each piece of Mail when giving one to one of your Pokémon. This message can be sent to other Trainers by trading Pokémon. When taking a piece of Mail from a Pokémon, you may choose to place it in their Bag or send it to their Mailbox. You can store it in the Mailbox to preserve the original message.<\/p>\n  <p>You can go downstairs by stepping on the stairs in the northeast corner of the room.<\/p>\n\n  <h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr1-1f\">1F<\/h5>\n  <p>Your Mom is sitting at the table and tells you that Professor Oak has been looking for you. To leave the house, step on the floor mat along the south wall and press down on the +Control Pad.<\/p>\n\n  <h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr1-oak\">Oak Appears!<\/h4>\n  <p>Exit the house. Pallet Town has only a few places to explore, and Professor Oak is nowhere to be found. Head for the tall grass on the north side of town. Suddenly, the professor appears! He scolds you for trying to venture off on your own, as it can be dangerous without a Pokémon of your own for defense against wild Pokémon. He will take you to his lab.<\/p>\n\n  <h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr1-lab\">Professor Oak's Lab<\/h4>\n  <p>Inside his lab Blue is already waiting and gives you the choice of your very first Pokémon. Each has its advantages and disadvantages, so simply choose the one that you like the best.<\/p>\n\n  <div class=\"wt-starters\"><div class=\"wt-starter\"><img src=\"@@IMG2@@\" alt=\"Bulbasaur\" are done selecting a Pokémon, you can nickname it if you like. Your rival will pick next and choose the one that has a type advantage over your Pokémon. As you try to leave, he will challenge you to a Pokémon battle!<\/p>\n\n  <h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr1-rival1\">Rival Battle 1<\/h5>\n  <p>As you battle your rival, Professor Oak explains the basics. When battling another Trainer, one Pokémon is sent out at a time, and both Pokémon are at Level 5, which is written next to the Pokémon's name. Below is the green health bar, which shows your Pokémon's remaining HP. You win a battle by lowering your opponent's Pokémon's HP to 0. Winning a battle gives you experience points that will level up your Pokémon, and it will eventually evolve.<\/p>\n  <p>Choosing Fight shows you the attacks you can use against your opponent. Each of the Pokémon will have two moves. The first move can damage your opponent and the other one lowers its stats. You can restore your Pokémon to full health when it is low on HP. You can also buy Potions from the Poké Mart to heal your Pokémon on the go.<\/p>\n\n  <div class=\"wt-rivals\">\n    <div class=\"wt-rival\">\n  <div class=\"wt-rival-head\"><img src=\"@@IMG11@@\"             'firered-p2': { title: 'Pokémon Fire Red Walkthrough Part 2', imgs: FR2_IMG, html: "<div class=\"wt-guide\">\n<details class=\"wt-collapse wt-toc\" open><summary>Contents<\/summary><div class=\"wt-collapse-body\"><ol class=\"wt-toc-list\">\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-route1\" data-jump>Route 1<\/a><ul><li><a href=\"#fr2-sample\" data-jump>Free Sample<\/a><\/li><\/ul><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-viridian\" data-jump>Viridian City<\/a><ul><li><a href=\"#fr2-center\" data-jump>Pokémon Center<\/a><\/li><li><a href=\"#fr2-mart\" data-jump>Poké Mart<\/a><\/li><li><a href=\"#fr2-delivery\" data-jump>Special Delivery<\/a><\/li><li><a href=\"#fr2-academy\" data-jump>Pokémon Academy<\/a><\/li><\/ul><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-pallet\" data-jump>Pallet Town<\/a><ul><li><a href=\"#fr2-lab\" data-jump>Professor Oak's Lab<\/a><\/li><li><a href=\"#fr2-blue\" data-jump>Blue's House<\/a><\/li><\/ul><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-viridian2\" data-jump>Viridian City (Return Visit)<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-route22\" data-jump>Route 22<\/a><ul><li><a href=\"#fr2-rival2\" data-jump>Rival Battle 2<\/a><\/li><\/ul><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-route2\" data-jump>Route 2<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-forest\" data-jump>Viridian Forest<\/a><\/li>\n<li><a href=\"#fr2-pewter\" data-jump>Pewter City<\/a><ul><li><a href=\"#fr2-gym\" data-jump>Pewter Gym<\/a><\/li><\/ul><\/li>\n<\/ol><\/div><\/details>\n\n<h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr2-route1\">Route 1<\/h4>\n<div class=\"wt-townrow\">\n  <figure class=\"wt-figure\"><img src=\"@@IMG1@@\" alt=\"Route 1 map\" width=\"300\" height=\"500\" class=\"wt-px\"><figcaption>Route 1<\/figcaption><\/figure>\n  <div style=\"flex:1 1 280px\">\n    <p>It is a quaint country road that lies north of Pallet Town and leads to Viridian City. Route 1 includes ledges, so the player must travel through the tall grass. It is not possible to catch Pokémon yet, but it is a good place to gain experience and level up your Pokémon.<\/p>\n    <h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-sample\">Free Sample<\/h5>\n    <p>Talk to the guy on the south side of the route, near the signpost. He works at the Poké Mart in Viridian City and gives you a Potion as a free sample.<\/p>\n  <\/div>\n<\/div>\n\n<details class=\"wt-collapse\" open><summary>Items<\/summary><div class=\"wt-collapse-body\"><div class=\"wt-table-wrap\"><table class=\"wt-table wt-items\"><thead><tr><th>Item<\/th><th>Location<\/th><th>Games<\/th><\/tr><\/thead><tbody><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG2@@\" alt=\"Oak's Parcel\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Oak's Parcel<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>Poké Mart; from the shopkeeper<\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG3@@\" alt=\"Potion\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Potion<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>Near the city's north exit, west of the small tree (later visit)<\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG4@@\" alt=\"Teachy TV\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Teachy TV<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>From the old man who demonstrates how to catch a Pokémon<\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG5@@\" alt=\"TM26 (Earthquake)\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>TM26 (Earthquake)<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>From the Gym Leader, after defeating him<\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/div><\/div><\/details>\n\n<h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr2-viridian\">Viridian City<\/h4>\n<div class=\"wt-townrow\">\n  <figure class=\"wt-figure\"><img src=\"@@IMG6@@\" alt=\"Viridian City map\" width=\"300\" height=\"250\" class=\"wt-px\"><figcaption>Viridian City<\/figcaption><\/figure>\n  <p>It is a tiny city that is surrounded by green all year round. It is situated between Route 1 to the south, Route 2 to the north, and Route 22 to the west.<\/p>\n<\/div>\n\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-center\">Pokémon Center<\/h5>\n<p>The first building is the Pokémon Center. It is useful for healing your Pokémon any time they are low on health and for removing status conditions. You can use the PC to store Pokémon that you don't want to keep in your active party. There are 30 boxes, so there's plenty of space. The Withdraw and Deposit options let you quickly take Pokémon out of storage or put them in. The Item option allows you to take the item each Pokémon is holding while it is in storage.<\/p>\n\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-mart\">Poké Mart<\/h5>\n<details class=\"wt-collapse\" open><summary>Poké Mart<\/summary><div class=\"wt-collapse-body\"><div class=\"wt-mart\"><div class=\"wt-mart-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG7@@\" alt=\"Poké Ball\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Poké Ball<\/span><strong>$200<\/strong><\/div><div class=\"wt-mart-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG3@@\" alt=\"Potion\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Potion<\/span><strong>$300<\/strong><\/div><div class=\"wt-mart-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG8@@\" alt=\"Antidote\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Antidote<\/span><strong>$100<\/strong><\/div><div class=\"wt-mart-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG9@@\" alt=\"Parlyz Heal\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-icon wt-px\"><span>Parlyz Heal<\/span><strong>$200<\/strong><\/div><\/div><\/div><\/details>\n<p>It is located to the right of the Pokémon Center. You can buy different items such as Poké Balls, Potions, Antidotes, and Parlyz Heals. More items become available as you progress through the game.<\/p>\n\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-delivery\">Special Delivery<\/h5>\n<p>As soon as you enter the Mart, the shopkeeper asks you if you are from Pallet Town and hands over Professor Oak's package to you. He asks you to deliver it to the Professor. You can't buy anything yet.<\/p>\n\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-academy\">Pokémon Academy<\/h5>\n<p>It teaches different basic knowledge regarding Pokémon to inexperienced or new Trainers. The blackboards describe the five different status conditions and their effects:<\/p>\n<div class=\"wt-table-wrap\"><table class=\"wt-table\"><thead><tr><th>Ailment<\/th><th>Effect(s)<\/th><\/tr><\/thead><tbody><tr><td><span class=\"wt-game\">BRN<\/span> Burn<\/td><td>Attack drops to 50%; inflicts damage equal to 1/8 of maximum HP every turn<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FRZ<\/span> Freeze<\/td><td>Cannot move until thawed<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-game\">PAR<\/span> Paralysis<\/td><td>Speed drops to 25%; cannot attack 1/4 of the time<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-game\">PSN<\/span> Poison<\/td><td>Inflicts damage equal to 1/8 of maximum HP every turn; loses 1 HP for every five steps taken outside of battle<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-game\">SLP<\/span> Sleep<\/td><td>Cannot move for one to six turns<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/div>\n\n<h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr2-pallet\">Pallet Town<\/h4>\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-lab\">Professor Oak's Lab<\/h5>\n<p>As soon as you deliver Oak's parcel to him, your rival Blue appears. The Professor gives you and your rival a Pokédex, which records data on a Pokémon when it is caught. He asks you and your rival to go and complete the Pokédex since he can't in his old age. He also gives you five Poké Balls to help you catch Pokémon as part of filling the Pokédex.<\/p>\n<h5 class=\"wt-h2\" id=\"fr2-blue\">Blue's House<\/h5>\n<p>Talk to his sister Daisy to receive a Town Map.<\/p>\n<figure class=\"wt-figure\" style=\"margin:1rem 0;text-align:left\"><img src=\"@@IMG10@@\" alt=\"Kanto region map\" width=\"240\" height=\"160\" class=\"wt-px\"><figcaption>Kanto Region Map<\/figcaption><\/figure>\n\n<h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr2-viridian2\">Viridian City (Return Visit)<\/h4>\n<p>When you reach Viridian City again, talk to the old guy who will be up now that he has had his coffee. He notices you have a Pokédex and gives you a demonstration of how to catch a Pokémon. Afterwards he gives you the Teachy TV, which contains videos explaining the basics of being a Trainer. Use it if you don't understand anything.<\/p>\n<p>You can head to either Route 2 or Route 22.<\/p>\n\n<h4 class=\"wt-h\" id=\"fr2-route22\">Route 22<\/h4>\n<p>It is not fully unlocked yet. There are a few different Pokémon available, such as:<\/p>\n<details class=\"wt-collapse\" open><summary>Available Pokémon<\/summary><div class=\"wt-collapse-body\"><div class=\"wt-table-wrap\"><table class=\"wt-table\"><thead><tr><th>Pokémon<\/th><th>Games<\/th><th>Location<\/th><th>Levels<\/th><th>Rate<\/th><\/tr><\/thead><tbody><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG11@@\" alt=\"Rattata\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Rattata<\/span><\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG12@@\" alt=\"Grass\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Grass<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>2-5<\/td><td>45%<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG13@@\" alt=\"Mankey\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Mankey<\/span><\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG12@@\" alt=\"Grass\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Grass<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>2-5<\/td><td>45%<\/td><\/tr><tr><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG14@@\" alt=\"Spearow\" width=\"32\" height=\"32\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Spearow<\/span><\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-game\">FR<\/span><span class=\"wt-game\">LG<\/span><\/td><td><span class=\"wt-item\"><img src=\"@@IMG12@@\" alt=\"Grass\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" class=\"wt-px\"><span>Grass<\/span><\/span><\/td><td>3, 5<\/td><td>10%<\/td><\/tr><\/tbody><\/table><\/div><\/div><\/details>\n<p>However, Blue appears and challenges you to a battle.         // Make sure the Pokémon FireRed entry always carries the built-in parts, in order
        // (works for brand-new visitors and for browsers that already saved data).
        function ensureBuiltinParts() {
            const list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs')) || [];
            const norm = s => (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '');
            const fr = list.find(w => norm(w.title) === 'pokémonfirered') || list.find(w => w.id === 1);
            if (!fr) return;
            fr.parts = fr.parts || [];
            let changed = false;
            let insertAt = 0;
            Object.keys(BUILTIN_PARTS).forEach(key => {
                const idx = fr.parts.findIndex(p => p.builtin === key);
                if (idx === -1) {
                    fr.parts.splice(insertAt, 0, { id: 'builtin-' + key, builtin: key, title: BUILTIN_PARTS[key].title });
                    insertAt += 1;
                    changed = true;
                } else {
                    insertAt = idx + 1;
                }
            });
            if (changed) localStorage.setItem('walkthroughs', JSON.stringify(list));
        }
        ensureBuiltinParts();

        function renderBuiltinPart(part) {
            const def = BUILTIN_PARTS[part.builtin];
            if (!def) return '';
            const body = def.html.replace(/@@IMG(\d+)@@/g, (m, n) => def.imgs[n] || '');
            return `<div class="wt-part-wrap"><h3>${def.title}</h3>${body}</div>`;
        }

        // Navigation
        function showSection(sectionId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(section => {
                section.style.display = 'none';
            });
            document.getElementById(sectionId).style.display = 'block';
            
            // Load section content
            if (sectionId === 'walkthroughs') loadWalkthroughs();
            if (sectionId === 'myromhacks') loadMyRomHacks();
            if (sectionId === 'guides') loadGuides();
            if (sectionId === 'home') loadHome();
            if (sectionId === 'pokedex') loadPokedex();
            if (sectionId === 'romhacks') loadRomHacksHub();
            if (sectionId === 'videos') loadVideos();
        }

        // Modal functions
        function showAdminLogin() {
            document.getElementById('admin-login-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeModal(modalId) {
            document.getElementById(modalId).classList.remove('active');
        }

        function adminLogin(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const password = document.getElementById('admin-password').value;
            const messageDiv = document.getElementById('login-message');
            
            if (password === ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
                isAdmin = true;
                messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="success-msg">Login successful! Admin features enabled.</div>';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    closeModal('admin-login-modal');
                    showAdminPanels();
                }, 1000);
            } else {
                messageDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="error-msg">Incorrect password!</div>';
            }
        }

        function showAdminPanels() {
            document.getElementById('admin-walkthrough-panel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('admin-myromhacks-panel').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function showAddWalkthroughModal() {
            document.getElementById('add-walkthrough-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function showAddMyRomHackModal() {
            document.getElementById('add-myromhack-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function addWalkthrough(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!isAdmin) return;

            const walkthroughs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs'));
            const newWalkthrough = {
                id: Date.now(),
                title: document.getElementById('wt-title').value,
                type: document.getElementById('wt-type').value,
                description: document.getElementById('wt-description').value,
                image: document.getElementById('wt-image').value,
                parts: []
            };

            walkthroughs.push(newWalkthrough);
            localStorage.setItem('walkthroughs', JSON.stringify(walkthroughs));

            document.getElementById('add-walkthrough-message').innerHTML = '<div class="success-msg">Walkthrough added successfully!</div>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                closeModal('add-walkthrough-modal');
                loadWalkthroughs();
                event.target.reset();
            }, 1000);
        }

        function showAddPartModal(gameId) {
            document.getElementById('part-game-id').value = gameId;
            document.getElementById('add-part-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function addWalkthroughPart(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!isAdmin) return;

            const gameId = parseInt(document.getElementById('part-game-id').value);
            const walkthroughs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs'));
            const game = walkthroughs.find(w => w.id === gameId);

            if (game) {
                const newPart = {
                    id: Date.now(),
                    title: document.getElementById('part-title').value,
                    videoUrl: document.getElementById('part-video').value,
                    content: document.getElementById('part-content').value,
                    tips: document.getElementById('part-tips').value
                };

                game.parts.push(newPart);
                localStorage.setItem('walkthroughs', JSON.stringify(walkthroughs));

                document.getElementById('add-part-message').innerHTML = '<div class="success-msg">Part added successfully!</div>';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    closeModal('add-part-modal');
                    event.target.reset();
                }, 1000);
            }
        }

        function addMyRomHack(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!isAdmin) return;

            const romHacks = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('myRomHacks'));
            const newRomHack = {
                id: Date.now(),
                title: document.getElementById('mrh-title').value,
                description: document.getElementById('mrh-description').value,
                features: document.getElementById('mrh-features').value.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim()),
                version: document.getElementById('mrh-version').value,
                patchUrl: document.getElementById('mrh-patch').value,
                devLog: document.getElementById('mrh-devlog').value,
                image: document.getElementById('mrh-image').value
            };

            romHacks.push(newRomHack);
            localStorage.setItem('myRomHacks', JSON.stringify(romHacks));

            document.getElementById('add-myromhack-message').innerHTML = '<div class="success-msg">ROM Hack added successfully!</div>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                closeModal('add-myromhack-modal');
                loadMyRomHacks();
                event.target.reset();
            }, 1000);
        }

        // Load functions
        function loadWalkthroughs() {
            const walkthroughs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs'));
            const grid = document.getElementById('walkthroughs-grid');
            
            grid.innerHTML = walkthroughs.map(wt => `
                <div class="card walkthrough-card" data-type="${wt.type}">
                    ${wt.image ? `<img src="${wt.image}" alt="${wt.title}" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 1rem;">` : ''}
                    <h3>${wt.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${wt.type === 'official' ? 'Official Game' : 'ROM Hack'}</span>
                    <p>${wt.description}</p>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem; display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                        <button class="btn" onclick="viewWalkthrough(${wt.id})">View Walkthrough</button>
                        ${isAdmin ? `<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="showAddPartModal(${wt.id})">+ Add Part</button>` : ''}
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function viewWalkthrough(id) {
            const walkthroughs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs'));
            const wt = walkthroughs.find(w => w.id === id);
            
            if (!wt) return;

            const partsHtml = wt.parts.map(part => {
                if (part.builtin) return renderBuiltinPart(part);
                const videoId = extractYouTubeId(part.videoUrl || '');
                return `
                    <div class="walkthrough-part" style="cursor: default; margin-bottom: 2rem;">
                        <h3 style="color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 1rem;">${part.title}</h3>
                        ${videoId ? `
                            <div class="video-container">
                                <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>
                            </div>
                        ` : ''}
                        <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem; color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.9); line-height: 1.8;">
                            ${part.content.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
                        </div>
                        ${part.tips ? `
                            <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: rgba(255, 222, 0, 0.1); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px;">
                                <strong style="color: var(--accent);">💡 Key Tips & Items:</strong><br>
                                ${part.tips.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
                            </div>
                        ` : ''}
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            const content = `
                <div class="game-header">
                    <h2>${wt.title}</h2>
                    <p style="margin-top: 1rem; font-size: 1.1rem;">${wt.description}</p>
                </div>
                ${wt.parts.length > 0 ? partsHtml : '<p style="text-align: center; color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.6);">No walkthrough parts added yet.</p>'}
            `;

            document.getElementById('walkthrough-detail-content').innerHTML = content;
            document.getElementById('walkthrough-detail-modal').classList.add('active');
            document.querySelector('#walkthrough-detail-modal .modal-content').scrollTop = 0;
        }

        function extractYouTubeId(url) {
            const regExp = /^.*((youtu.be\/)|(v\/)|(\/u\/\w\/)|(embed\/)|(watch\?))\??v?=?([^#&?]*).*/;
            const match = url.match(regExp);
            return (match && match[7].length === 11) ? match[7] : null;
        }

        function loadMyRomHacks() {
            const romHacks = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('myRomHacks'));
            const grid = document.getElementById('myromhacks-grid');
            
            grid.innerHTML = romHacks.map(rh => `
                <div class="card">
                    ${rh.image ? `<img src="${rh.image}" alt="${rh.title}" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 1rem;">` : ''}
                    <h3>${rh.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${rh.version}</span>
                    <p>${rh.description}</p>
                    ${rh.features.length > 0 ? `
                        <div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
                            <strong style="color: var(--accent);">Features:</strong>
                            <ul style="margin-top: 0.5rem; padding-left: 1.5rem; color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.8);">
                                ${rh.features.map(f => `<li>${f}</li>`).join('')}
                            </ul>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                    ${rh.devLog ? `
                        <div style="margin-top: 1rem; padding: 1rem; background: rgba(59, 76, 202, 0.1); border-radius: 8px;">
                            <strong style="color: var(--secondary);">📝 Dev Log:</strong><br>
                            <span style="color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.8);">${rh.devLog}</span>
                        </div>
                    ` : ''}
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <a href="${rh.patchUrl}" class="btn btn-primary" download>⬇ Download Patch</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function loadGuides() {
            const guides = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('guides'));
            const grid = document.getElementById('guides-grid');
            
            grid.innerHTML = guides.map(guide => `
                <div class="card">
                    <h3>${guide.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${guide.category}</span>
                    <p>${guide.content.substring(0, 150)}...</p>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn">Read More</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function loadHome() {
            const walkthroughs = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('walkthroughs'));
            const guides = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('guides'));
            const grid = document.getElementById('latest-content');
            
            const latest = [
                ...walkthroughs.slice(-2).map(wt => ({...wt, type: 'walkthrough'})),
                ...guides.slice(-2).map(g => ({...g, type: 'guide'}))
            ];

            grid.innerHTML = latest.map(item => `
                <div class="card">
                    <h3>${item.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${item.type === 'walkthrough' ? 'Walkthrough' : 'Guide'}</span>
                    <p>${item.description || item.content?.substring(0, 100) + '...'}</p>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn" onclick="showSection('${item.type === 'walkthrough' ? 'walkthroughs' : 'guides'}')">View ${item.type === 'walkthrough' ? 'Walkthrough' : 'Guide'}</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function loadPokedex() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('pokedex-grid');
            const samplePokemon = [
                { num: 1, name: 'Bulbasaur', type: ['grass'], gen: 'gen1' },
                { num: 4, name: 'Charmander', type: ['fire'], gen: 'gen1' },
                { num: 7, name: 'Squirtle', type: ['water'], gen: 'gen1' },
                { num: 25, name: 'Pikachu', type: ['electric'], gen: 'gen1' },
                { num: 152, name: 'Chikorita', type: ['grass'], gen: 'gen2' },
                { num: 155, name: 'Cyndaquil', type: ['fire'], gen: 'gen2' }
            ];

            grid.innerHTML = samplePokemon.map(p => `
                <div class="card" data-gen="${p.gen}">
                    <h3>#${String(p.num).padStart(3, '0')} ${p.name}</h3>
                    <div style="margin: 1rem 0;">
                        ${p.type.map(t => `<span class="type-badge type-${t}">${t}</span>`).join(' ')}
                    </div>
                    <p>Click to view complete stats, moves, locations, and evolution details.</p>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn">View Details</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function loadRomHacksHub() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('romhacks-grid');
            const sampleRomHacks = [
                { title: 'Pokémon Gaia', region: 'hoenn', difficulty: 'easy', description: 'A quality ROM hack with new region Orbtus' },
                { title: 'Pokémon Unbound', region: 'hoenn', difficulty: 'hard', description: 'Professional-grade hack with modern features' },
                { title: 'Pokémon Radical Red', region: 'kanto', difficulty: 'hard', description: 'Enhanced FireRed with competitive difficulty' }
            ];

            grid.innerHTML = sampleRomHacks.map(rh => `
                <div class="card" data-region="${rh.region}" data-difficulty="${rh.difficulty}">
                    <h3>${rh.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${rh.difficulty}</span>
                    <p>${rh.description}</p>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn">View Details</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function loadVideos() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('playlists-grid');
            const playlists = [
                { title: 'Pokémon Ash Gray Complete Series', channel: 'Trainer\'s Odyssey' },
                { title: 'Pokémon FireRed Nuzlocke', channel: 'Trainer\'s Odyssey' },
                { title: 'Naruto Ultimate Ninja Impact', channel: 'Handhold Havoc' },
                { title: 'God of War PSP Collection', channel: 'Handhold Havoc' }
            ];

            grid.innerHTML = playlists.map(pl => `
                <div class="card">
                    <h3>${pl.title}</h3>
                    <span class="card-tag">${pl.channel}</span>
                    <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn">Watch Playlist</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // Filter functions
        function filterWalkthroughs(type) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.walkthrough-card');
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.filters .filter-btn');
            
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');

            cards.forEach(card => {
                if (type === 'all' || card.dataset.type === type) {
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

        function filterPokedex(gen) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#pokedex-grid .card');
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#pokedex .filters .filter-btn');
            
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');

            cards.forEach(card => {
                if (gen === 'all' || card.dataset.gen === gen) {
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

        function filterRomHacks(filter) {
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#romhacks-grid .card');
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#romhacks .filters .filter-btn');
            
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');

            cards.forEach(card => {
                if (filter === 'all' || 
                    card.dataset.region === filter || 
                    card.dataset.difficulty === filter.replace('difficulty-', '')) {
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        }

        // Search functionality
        document.getElementById('walkthrough-search')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const searchTerm = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.walkthrough-card');
            
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const title = card.querySelector('h3').textContent.toLowerCase();
                const description = card.querySelector('p').textContent.toLowerCase();
                
                if (title.includes(searchTerm) || description.includes(searchTerm)) {
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        });

        document.getElementById('pokedex-search')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const searchTerm = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
            const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#pokedex-grid .card');
            
            cards.forEach(card => {
                const title = card.querySelector('h3').textContent.toLowerCase();
                
                if (title.includes(searchTerm)) {
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                } else {
                    card.style.display = 'none';
                }
            });
        });

        // Contents links inside the walkthrough modal: scroll the modal, not the page
        document.getElementById('walkthrough-detail-content').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const link = e.target.closest('a[data-jump]');
            if (!link) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = document.getElementById(link.getAttribute('href').slice(1));
            if (target) target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        });

        // Header: hide while scrolling down, reveal on scroll up so it never blocks the page
        (function () {
            const header = document.querySelector('header');
            const SHOW_ZONE = 80;   // always visible near the top
            const THRESHOLD = 8;    // ignore tiny scroll jitters
            let lastY = window.scrollY;
            let ticking = false;

            function update() {
                const y = Math.max(window.scrollY, 0);
                const delta = y - lastY;
                if (y < SHOW_ZONE) {
                    header.classList.remove('header-hidden');
                } else if (delta > THRESHOLD) {
                    header.classList.add('header-hidden');
                } else if (delta < -THRESHOLD) {
                    header.classList.remove('header-hidden');
                }
                if (Math.abs(delta) > THRESHOLD) lastY = y;
                ticking = false;
            }

            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                if (!ticking) {
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
                    ticking = true;
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        })();

        // Initialize
        showSection('home');
    </script>
</body>
</html>
